(for example `step-5-preview-free`'s 1M window). A metadata outage silently
falls back t"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"o the defaults and never blocks discovery; set

- Zen client "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"fingerprint aligned with the 2026-10-14 free-tier gate: the
official `opencode/<channel>/<version>/c"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"li` User-Agent, session ids in the

a bare 40-character hex project header, no `x-opencode-request`, and the
five injected cor"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"e tools (shell/edit/glob/grep/read) carrying the official
definitions — both synthesised stubs and t"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"he old shapes get 403

a configured account key keeps using `zenBaseUrl`.
- "},{"id":"p10s15","text":"Text-output and tool-capable models only, suitable for DSH agent turns.

| `providerId` |"},{"id":"p21s2","text":" `kilo2dsh` | DSH route name. |
| `gatewayBaseUrl` | `https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway` | Kilo-compat"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ible gateway base URL. |

| `requireTo"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ols` | `true` | Hide free models that do not advertise `tools`. |

| `zenProviderId` | `opencode2dsh` | DSH route name for Zen. |
| `zenBas"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"eUrl` | `https://opencode.ai/zen` | OpenCode Zen root URL. |
| `zenUserAgent` | empty | Optional com"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"patibility User-Agent; empty derives the OpenCode format. |
| `zenApiKeyEnv` | empty | Optional Zen "},{"id":"p21s12","text":"account-token environment variable. |
